findings.desc: Framework doc still says Quantum is a future design contract, not a delivered runtime implementation, but B-5118 registers a read-only quantum ClaimAdmissibilityPack by default through QUANTUM_CLAIM_ADMISSIBILITY_PACK and DEFAULT_CLAIM_ADMISSIBILITY_PACKS. Update wording to distinguish full future pack/gate integration from the now-implemented M2 read-only descriptor and normalization pack.
